newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BNDESPar, CVRD workers to bid at auction.
newsitem.headline: BNDESPar, CVRD workers to bid at auction.

text.p: Brazil's BNDESPar and employees of state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) have agreed to join forces to form a consortium to participate in the company's privatisation auction, Jornal do Brasil daily said.
The newspaper said BNDESPar, the investment arm of Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES), is likely to hold a stake in Vale in the first years after the firm is privatized.

Vale's privatisation is expected to begin in April, with the sale of a 40-45 percent voting stake in the firm. The block sale will be followed by share offerings to employees and investors on the domestic and international markets in a second and third phases.
Vale's tender documents are expected to come out next Wednesday when the National Privatization Council (CND) meets, the newspaper said.
